name: Aetobarbakinoides
sum: Aetobarbakinoides is a stagonolepidid aetosaur from the Late Triassic Santa Maria Supersequence of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, one of the oldest aetosaurs.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Collected at the Inhamandá locality, Hyperodapedon Assemblage Zone, Santa Maria Supersequence, Rio Grande do Sul; the catalogue number is not given in the sources consulted.
material: The holotype only, diagnosed mainly from vertebrae rather than osteoderms.
biology: The sources consulted describe its anatomy and age but give no direct evidence of diet or habits.
author: Desojo et al. 2012

sources.text: J. B. Desojo, M. D. Ezcurra, and E. E. Kischlat. 2012. A new aetosaur genus (Archosauria: Pseudosuchia) from the early Late Triassic of southern Brazil. Zootaxa 3166:1-33
